{"title":"Monthly Gross Booking Value vs Realized Revenue in 2024","sql":"
SELECT 
  `Booking Month`,
  MEASURE(`Gross Booking Value`) AS `gross_booking_value`,
  MEASURE(`Realized Revenue`) AS `realized_revenue`,
  MEASURE(`Gross Booking Value`) - MEASURE(`Realized Revenue`) AS `difference`
FROM `workspace`.`genie_demo`.`booking_metrics`
WHERE `Booking Year` = 2024
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY `Booking Month` ASC
"}

{"title":"Total 2024 Gross Booking Value vs Realized Revenue","sql":"
SELECT 
  MEASURE(`Gross Booking Value`) AS `gross_booking_value`,
  MEASURE(`Realized Revenue`) AS `realized_revenue`,
  MEASURE(`Gross Booking Value`) - MEASURE(`Realized Revenue`) AS `difference`,
  (MEASURE(`Gross Booking Value`) - MEASURE(`Realized Revenue`)) / MEASURE(`Gross Booking Value`) * 100 AS `difference_pct`
FROM `workspace`.`genie_demo`.`booking_metrics`
WHERE `Booking Year` = 2024
GROUP BY ALL
"}

## Gross Booking Value vs Realized Revenue in 2024

In 2024, **Gross Booking Value totaled $12.3M while Realized Revenue was $4.5M**, representing a **63.7% difference** of $7.8M. \[[1](https://example.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1cc1054581cf2a16811f9028898a4/chats/01f1cc119f2610bdbe2cb65c81444c91?o=0&gra_focus=toolu_bdrk_01gac8xifelfen7dtukqgjky)\]

**Gross Booking Value** includes all bookings regardless of status (pending, cancelled, confirmed, and completed), while **Realized Revenue** only counts confirmed and completed bookings. The substantial gap reflects bookings that were either cancelled or remain pending.

### Monthly Trend

The gap between Gross Booking Value and Realized Revenue grew throughout the year:
- **January-February**: The difference was approximately $240K per month
- **Peak summer months (June-August)**: The gap expanded to $700K-$800K per month
- **Year-end (November-December)**: The difference reached its highest levels at $979K and $1.15M respectively

This widening gap during peak travel seasons suggests higher booking volumes combined with elevated cancellation rates or a larger proportion of bookings remaining in pending status during busy periods. \[[2](https://example.cloud.databricks.com/genie/rooms/01f1cc1054581cf2a16811f9028898a4/chats/01f1cc119f2610bdbe2cb65c81444c91?o=0&gra_focus=toolu_bdrk_01uprg2unbnauhydmffqq43x)\]
